text:
alana: quick proposal — 'Mosaic' filter-groups for Console analytics. idea: let users compose a small set of saved filters (mix of per-route + per-model) and surface them as a tile grid. can be toggled on/off per-team and pinned per-route. low friction, supports cross-route comparisons.

josh: curious about routing + quota semantics. if tile A is per-route and tile B is per-model, what happens when a request is routed to a fallback model? do we show the model tile or the route tile?

maria: +1 on mosaic concept. from infra side we need to decide which telemetry keys drive each tile. model-tile = model_name + model_version, route-tile = route_id + route_version. fallback means tile should show both: primary route metrics but annotate model fallback events.

samir: UX/SDK question — saved filters currently have a single "scope" field (team|org|route). we'll need a lightweight change to allow composite scope: e.g. ["route:123","model:gpt-neox-20b@v2"]. Is that an API bump or backward-compatible?

josh: API-wise we can be backwards compatible. proposal: keep existing saved_filters table + add saved_filter_bindings table (many-to-many binding to scope keys). That avoids changing the contract for old clients.

leo: design note: tiles should show two small badges — sample_rate and quota_impact (est. tokens/hr). Also an overflow menu to open raw query or duplicate filter. mock incoming later.

nina: telemetry caveat: many routes have aggressive sampling (1%). if a mosaic tile mixes route+model it will create sparse time series. we should: (1) compute weighted estimates from sampled logs, (2) show a sampling badge, (3) include raw count when available. otherwise people will misread.

deploy-bot: deploy-preview created for feature branch feature/mosaic-filters — preview at https://staging.console.redwood/dev/mosaic (expires in 48h)

alana: thanks. next items I want us to agree on: binding model for saved filters, display badges (sampling + quota), and rollout plan (canary rules).

josh: implementation notes from platform: if we add saved_filter_bindings we should also index by (scope_key, tenant) for fast lookups. route-to-model join must be precomputed for dashboard queries; otherwise query perf will tank.

samir: +1 on precompute. can we reuse the existing route-insights aggregation pipeline? that already emits per-route, per-model aggregates at 1m buckets. either reuse or add a lightweight transform.

maria: backend perf warning: precomputing joins is fine, but quantization (for token-cost est) depends on request_size distribution — we should include a small histogram in the aggregate so quota_impact is an estimate with a CI.

alana: API sketch (proto) — keeping it tiny to review:
```json
POST /api/console/saved_filters
{
  "name": "perf - mosaic",
  "description": "Per-route + model tiles for checkout flows",
  "bindings": ["route:checkout","model:gpt-neox-20b@v2"],
  "visibility": "team"
}
```
We return a saved_filter_id and binding array.

leo: for UX, saved link should deep-link to mosaic view with ?filters=saved_filter_id and optionally ?focus=tile_id. permalink behavior unchanged.

nina: for telemetry/alerts, recommend we emit a "mosaic_exposure" metric (counts of mosaic tile renders by org) so we can watch adoption and sampling effects.

josh: rollout plan idea: canary to 10% active orgs flagged by traffic tiers (low->medium). default off for enterprise until compliance sign-off. add quota-preview CTA inside tile that runs a dry-run on a sampled window.

samir: operationally, the quota-preview should be async and cached per org+filter for 6h. cost to compute = small aggregate scan, but cached helps.

alana: timeline: design + API decision this week, platform + aggregations work next sprint, canary the week after. quick check: any blockers?

maria: need a short doc on how fallback models are annotated in aggregates. I'll put one in the PR.

josh: dev task: I'll add DB migration for saved_filter_bindings and a new index. ping me for review.

samir: SDK change: add SavedFilter.bindings: string[] and a convenience method to resolve effective scope. tiny change.

leo: will drop 3 mock screens by EOD.

alana: awesome. quick sync tomorrow 10am to lock API. thanks all :thumbsup:

samir: :thumbsup:

josh: :eyes:

nina: flagged a follow-up about sampling math in #eng-ml
